name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / Red Chile Lateral
monitor_reason: Endpoints and length are not stated, and no source says this lateral serves a data center. It may be part of the Desert Southwest Expansion scope already in P7840.
researcher_notes: A Source NM article from August 2026 says filings with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission show a planned Red Chile Lateral tied to the Desert Southwest Pipeline Expansion Project. It says the lateral would sit 50 feet from the Green Chile Project. The article does not give a length, endpoints, capacity or diameter. It does not say the lateral serves Project Jupiter or any data center, so DataCenter stays blank. The only other hits were republished copies of the same story and an advocacy letter to FERC that cites docket PF26-9-000. That docket was not read. The sponsor is Energy Transfer through Transwestern. The lateral is distinct from P8290 Green Chile Project but may fall inside the P7840 Desert Southwest Expansion row. Next step is to read the FERC filing in that docket for the lateral length and delivery point. Confidence is low.
